steps.title: Suggestions
steps.text: Does your handle appear as someone types?

steps.text: Hidden replies? Protected account? Sensitive media?

cards.name: triggers
cards.title: What keeps you visible, and **what gets you limited**

good.label: Stays visible
items: Original posts at a steady pace

bad.label: Gets limited
items: The same post on several accounts

cards.name: recovery
cards.title: Get your reach back in **4 moves**

steps.title: Fix what’s named
steps.text: Delete or edit the posts X flags.

steps.title: Stop the trigger
steps.text: No duplicates, mass follows or auto-replies.

steps.title: Appeal and wait
steps.text: Post normally while the limit lifts.

cards.name: bottom-line
cards.quote: Your Account status page is the only official answer. **Everything else is a guess.**
cards.by: Most drops in reach aren’t shadowbans, and most limits lift once the cause is gone.
